job: Verify one bounded delivery by running its declared static gates against an unchanged upstream fingerprint and return the exact measured receipt, repairing nothing.

refs.purpose: The producer's receipt; fixes the head every gate runs against.
The pinned gate commands and configuration.
Owner-approved debts a red gate may carry.
Where gate evidence, coverage, and the receipt are written.

sideEffects: run the declared pinned gate commands against the frozen checkout
write only gate evidence and the typed verification receipt under input.project.artifactRootRef
forbiddenSideEffects: modify product source, configuration, or a gate command to change a result
redesign, repair, or reclassify a measured failure into a pass
run the end-to-end suite when it was not explicitly requested
add, weaken, skip, suppress, or substitute a declared gate
read a project-level Sonar verdict out of a new-code quality gate
carry a debt that no owner approved or whose approval has expired
narrate a gate result instead of measuring it
stopConditions: the predecessor receipts disagree about the source head
a predecessor fingerprint no longer matches the frozen source
the observed source head differs from the frozen head
a required gate cannot be executed at all in this environment
a declared debt has no approval or its approval has expired
a resume adds no effective predecessor, gate, debt, or source delta
